art_instructions: Set the scene inside the cozy Greek classroom: soft blue walls with exposed wooden beams, bright natural light pouring in from a large window on the right, and a stone floor partly covered by a colorful geometric woven rug. Glaux the owl sits slightly left of center at a low, honey-colored wooden desk, facing right, shown at child’s eye level. She has round amber eyes, mottled brown-and-cream feathers, and a small green scarf tied at her neck; her tiny satchel hangs from the back of her chair. With her left wing she grips a thick blue crayon, mid-stroke, while her right wing holds a white sheet of paper steady. On the paper is a clear, simple picture of the school building with a triangular roof, a blue door, two windows, and a bright yellow sun drawn in the top corner; a few chunky crayons in primary colors lie neatly on the desk. In the left background, place a teacher’s podium with a small piece of blue-and-white pottery on top, and a low chalkboard on the wall with faint letters and numbers from earlier lessons. Add a potted green plant near the window and warm yellow accents on the chair legs and desk edges. The owl’s expression is focused and pleased, beak slightly open in concentration; no other characters are present, keeping a tidy, bright learning atmosphere.
